scope: Independent read-only pure/VM/JSDOM behavior review on exact frozen public assets; root rendered browser QA is separate.

checks.name: new payload strips only target cloud and exactly preserves original canonical bytes
all daylight and cloud scores match Python on exact common targets
strict daylight/cloud boundary and missing values stay paired and unknown
imported target clouds cannot override retained diagnostics
blank builder has no source/capacity defaults and preserves accepted intake
generated UTF-8 identity, source uncertainty, reset and malicious/prototype labels preserved
121 absolute DST slots paginate losslessly; cutoff/latest navigate only known readings; missing gap preserved
paging and generated declaration do not fetch, persist or alter reference capacity/context
new invalid Apply cancels older pending valid Apply and preserves exact accepted report
cancelled digest rejection cannot overwrite newer blocked status or accepted intake
paired MAE/RMSE are shown and all three control RMSE columns exported consistently
empty imported daylight scope remains selected, emits null scores and never falls back to frozen predictions
multiple assets/units use explicit limits, reject duplicates without changing intake, retain Unicode hashes and stream-local paging
newer valid Apply wins async generation and clears stale stream options; older completion cannot replace it

independent_enrichment.method: Exact values joined by normalized absolute target timestamps; stripping only target cloud also reproduces immutable first71 ZIP payload bytes.

resolved_cases.origin: Reviewer reproduced on previous frozen revision
resolved_cases.case: Pending valid Apply survived newer invalid Apply and cleared accepted intake
resolved_cases.current: Every Apply attempt invalidates pending generation before validation; deferred-digest probe preserves identical readiness export.

resolved_cases.case: Cancelled digest rejection overwrote newer blocked status
resolved_cases.current: Reviewer rejected obsolete digest; newer status and accepted readiness export remain identical.

resolved_cases.case: Old disabled selector labels remained after declaration reset
resolved_cases.current: Reviewer confirms zero selector options after winning valid Apply, with no accepted readings until fresh import.

diagnostic_contract.role: Canonical realized target weather; candidate cloud ignored; every comparator uses identical target rows.
diagnostic_contract.empty_daylight: Imported input remains selected; no frozen fallback; null error scores and blank numeric export cells.
diagnostic_contract.confidence: No stratum confidence intervals or future-performance claim inferred.

limitations: VM/JSDOM does not verify pixels, native browser layout or human usability.
Synthetic observations do not certify origin, quality, safety, authority or field detection performance.
No new network beyond canonical startup fetches, storage writes, primary model/scheduler edits or deployment performed.
